    AI Overview
    The 2026 Boston Marathon takes place on Monday, April 20, with staggered start times starting at 9:06 a.m. ET for wheelchair divisions, followed by elites, and four waves of runners through 11:21 a.m. ET. The race, a major event on Patriot's Day, attracts thousands of participants. 
    2026 Boston Marathon Start Times (ET) 
    • 9:06 a.m.: Men's Wheelchair
    • 9:09 a.m.: Women's Wheelchair
    • 9:30 a.m.: Handcycles & Duos
    • 9:37 a.m.:
      Professional Men
    • 9:47 a.m.: Professional Women
    • 9:50 a.m.: Para Athletics Division
    • 10:00 a.m.: Wave 1
    • 10:15 a.m.: Wave 2
    • 10:28 a.m.: Wave 3
    • 10:41 a.m.: Wave 4
    • 11:01 a.m.: Wave 5
    • 11:21 a.m.: Wave 6 
    Viewing Information 
    • Local TV: WCVB Channel 5
    • National TV: ESPN2 (coverage from 9 a.m. ET)
    • Streaming: fuboTV (free trial)
